rows.grounds: compound: tamas-guṇa-ukta-mārga-sthā; feminine singular subject describing one who abides in the path declared by the quality of tamas
compound: tamas-guṇa-virājitā; feminine singular subject describing one who shines or is resplendent with the quality of tamas

items.question: How does the goddess relate to the path and radiance associated with the quality of tamas?
premises: The goddess abides in the path declared by the quality of tamas.
The goddess shines with the quality of tamas.
items.inference: The goddess is both established in the way defined by tamas and manifestly radiant through that same quality.
uncertainties: Whether virājitā emphasizes active shining forth or being adorned by the quality of tamas is contextually ambiguous.
items.plain_english: She abides in the path declared by the quality of darkness and shines with the quality of darkness.
